text: Arim Holding Sarl held 6,091,386 ordinary shares of EdiliziAcrobatica S.p.A., equal to 73.3% of the company's subscribed and paid-up share capital, as of 19 April 2023.
short: Arim Holding Sarl holds 73.3% of EdiliziAcrobatica (April 2023 filing).

source.name: EdiliziAcrobatica S.p.A., board-list presentation letter from Arim Holding Sarl (company filing)
source.quote: azioni ordinarie della Società, pari al 73,3% (settantatre virgola tre per cento) del capitale
source.note: Translation: 'ordinary shares of the company, equal to 73.3% (seventy-three point three per cent) of the capital'. The letter, filed with the company, states Arim Holding Sarl held 6,091,386 ordinary shares at that date.
